_schema: EPC competency registry. APPEND one record per VERIFIED competency found (known or novel). This log is BOTH the consolidation artifact AND the dataset for the commonality hunt (search for an unknown REGULARITY across records). Protocol: every competency that survives interventional verification -> add a record; set gate to known|under-named|candidate-novel after the literature gate.

competencies.name: navigation
competencies.mechanism: hold a detour against the goal-pull

competencies.name: memory
competencies.mechanism: hold a cue across distractors/delay

competencies.name: accumulation/counting
competencies.mechanism: increment a running tally, stop at a threshold

competencies.name: sequencing
competencies.mechanism: touch t0 before t1 (track prerequisite/order)

competencies.name: delayed-gratification
competencies.mechanism: cash out at the peak of an unknown-height reward

competencies.name: regulation
competencies.mechanism: hold a setpoint against disturbance

competencies.name: rule-inference (one-shot)
competencies.mechanism: infer hidden good-type from reward feedback, then exploit (one-shot, does not re-adapt)
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: feedback ablation -> 0.33 exact chance; mid-episode flip -> 0.15 (one-shot)

competencies.name: rule-tracking (continual)
competencies.mechanism: track a good-type that flips after each success

competencies.name: conditional-selection (cued)
competencies.mechanism: read a start cue, hold it, select the rule

competencies.name: communication
competencies.mechanism: speaker+listener co-adapt a symbol<->meaning map (Lewis)

competencies.name: role-division
competencies.mechanism: anti-coordinate via mutual position-observation

competencies.name: contest-resolution
competencies.mechanism: break symmetry on who-is-closer to resolve a contested resource

competencies.name: fair-alternation
competencies.mechanism: reactive anti-coordination: flip own last action, partner's last action keeps out-of-phase
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: NEITHER channel-scramble NOR memory-wipe collapses it (reactive)

competencies.name: count-communication (compositional)
competencies.mechanism: speaker counts an item-stream then encodes the count in a 3-slot/2-symbol COMPOSITIONAL message; listener decodes the joint pattern
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: count-ablate -> chance AND channel-scramble -> chance (BOTH); per-slot drop shows 3/3 slots informative (compositional)
competencies.note: FIRST broken minimal-mechanism case: compositional structure emerges ONLY when a single minimal mechanism is insufficient for reward (peaked counts -> 1 bit -> single-symbol; uniform counts -> compositional). The minimal->compositional transition is dial-able by sufficiency-pressure.

competencies.name: stigmergy (environment-mediated coordination)
competencies.state_content: EXTERNALIZED -- a shared trail field in the WORLD (not internal state)
competencies.mechanism: 2 blind agents (no channel, no mutual obs) read+write a shared mark trail to forage; they read the PARTNER's trail to divide territory
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: no-trail -> 1.4/12 (collapse); OWN-trail-only -> 5.7 vs combined 8.1 (partner's trail matters = inter-agent); overlap falls 5.5->3.4 over training
competencies.note: EXTERNALIZED state: the coordination memory lives in the ENVIRONMENT (the trail), not the agents -- a qualitatively distinct option for the what-state-holds ladder (#4): state can be in-the-world, not in-the-agent. Third distinct multi-agent COORDINATION MEDIUM after symbol-channel (#10) and direct-observation (#11).

competencies.name: tool use / instrumental construction
competencies.state_content: instrumental sub-goal (modify the world to enable the goal)
competencies.mechanism: push a block into an impassable gap to build a bridge, then cross -- the goal is unreachable without first constructing the bridge (a non-rewarding sub-goal)
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: NO-block control -> 0.00 (goal physically unreachable without modifying the environment)
competencies.note: Cleanest DEMAND in the arc (no-block control is exactly 0.00). Like stigmergy (#15) the agent writes to the WORLD, but here for SELF-benefit (niche construction) not coordination -> the externalized-state axis (#7 in the commonality hunt) spans coordination AND self-instrumental cases.

competencies.name: reputation / indirect reciprocity (social memory)
competencies.state_content: a REPUTATION MAP: partner-id -> tracked type (structured memory over OTHER agents)
competencies.mechanism: track each recurring partner's revealed cooperate/defect history in memory; help known cooperators, refuse known defectors
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: discrim 0.92; ANONYMIZE partners -> 0.50 chance (needs WHO); MEMORY-WIPE -> 0.50 chance (needs accumulated history); BOTH essential
competencies.note: AUDIT-GUIDED probe (gap #2). ADDS A NEW KIND: a 4th coordination MEDIUM (social-memory, completing channel/observation/environment/social-memory) AND a new state-content type (a structured reputation MAP over other agents). => the search was NOT saturated; the audit found genuine uncovered ground and prevented a premature comprehensive claim. Also answers the deception negative: tracked reputation is the mechanism that could stabilize honest/strategic signaling that minimal cheap-talk could not.

competencies.name: abstraction / systematic generalization (relational, PARTIAL)
competencies.state_required: n/a (feedforward MLP; the relation is computed per-step, no memory)
competencies.state_content: a learned RELATION -- similarity(cue, each goal colour-vector) -- applied to HELD-OUT instances
competencies.mechanism: go to the goal whose colour-vector is most similar to the cue's; the comparison PARTIALLY transfers to colours never seen as a cue-match in training
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: TRAIN vs HELD-OUT colour split (a generalization gap, NOT an ablation): held-out colours appear only as DISTRACTORS in training. held-out-acc 0.59 vs chance 0.33 => genuine transfer; train 0.88 -> held-out 0.59 => +0.29 gap => INCOMPLETE. Pure per-instance memorization would leave held-out AT chance 0.33; it did not.
failed_by: pure per-instance lookup (would give held-out = chance 0.33 -- ruled out by the above-chance held-out)
competencies.lit_name: systematic / compositional generalization; relational abstraction (Fodor-Pylyshyn systematicity; the well-documented 'nets generalize relations only PARTIALLY' finding, e.g. SCAN/Lake-Baroni)
competencies.note: AUDIT-GUIDED probe (gap #1). THREE firsts: (1) FIRST GRADED/PARTIAL competency -- genuine but incomplete; the train->held-out GAP is itself the signature, not a binary pass/fail. (2) NEW KIND: relational abstraction / systematic generalization -- distinct from the belief-over-latent-rule meta cells (#7-9), which INFER a hidden rule from in-episode feedback; this GENERALIZES a learned relation to UNSEEN instances (a train/test property, not in-episode inference). (3) NEW DIAGNOSTIC MODALITY: a train/held-out generalization GAP rather than an ablation-collapse -- a qualitatively different kind of competency evidence. HONESTY NOTE: the automated verdict printed 'MEMORIZATION (no generalization)' because held-out 0.59 fell one point under the strong 0.6 bar; that label is FALSE for held-out 0.59 vs chance 0.33. The instrument's verdict logic was corrected to a 3-way band (genuine/partial/memorization) so 0.59 reads honestly as PARTIAL. => search still NOT saturated (gap #1 filled AND added a kind + a diagnostic modality). Known to science => still 0 new-to-science.

competencies.name: imitation / social learning (goal emulation)
competencies.state_required: n/a (feedforward MLP; reads the demonstrator each step)
competencies.state_content: another agent's BEHAVIOUR used as an information source about the (hidden) task goal
competencies.mechanism: observe a scripted demonstrator that walks toward the hidden-correct goal; identify + go to the goal it chose (goal-emulation). The correct goal is NOT in the learner's observation -- the demonstrator is the only signal.
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: FROZEN demonstrator (sits at centre, no behaviour to read) -> 0.08, BELOW chance 0.33 => the hidden goal is unfindable without the other agent. MISLEADING demonstrator (walks to a WRONG goal) -> 0.08 => the learner FOLLOWS it to the wrong goal, proving it copies the demonstrator's CHOICE (not another cue). needs-demonstrator +0.75; misled-by-demo +0.75.
competencies.metric: normal 0.83 vs frozen 0.08 vs mislead 0.08 (chance 0.33) -- the cleanest demand in the arc
failed_by: hidden goal absent from the learner's own observation
competencies.lit_name: social / observational learning; goal emulation (Bandura 1977; Tomasello -- emulation vs true action-level imitation)
competencies.note: AUDIT-GUIDED probe (gap #3, the LAST toy-demandable audit cell). ADDS A KIND: acquiring task/goal knowledge by OBSERVING ANOTHER AGENT'S BEHAVIOUR -- a distinct multi-agent INFORMATION mode, distinct from symbol-channel (#10), mutual-observation-for-anti-coordination (#11), and social-memory-of-types (#17): here the other agent is an information SOURCE about the goal itself. Mechanistically goal-EMULATION (copy the demonstrated choice), not necessarily action-level imitation. CONSEQUENCE: all THREE audit-named toy-demandable cells (#17 reputation, #18 abstraction, #19 imitation) came back GENUINE and EACH ADDED A KIND (3/3) -- the compass was worth building and the toy space was richer than 'exhausted' implied. The toy-demandable frontier is now EXHAUSTED; remaining red-team cells (theory-of-mind, causal reasoning, multi-step planning, teaching, coalition) are SCALE-GATED. Known to science => still 0 new-to-science.

competencies.name: predictive intention-reading (velocity-based goal attribution) -- theory-of-mind component
competencies.state_content: integrated MOTION history of another agent -> inferred heading -> attributed goal (intention)
competencies.mechanism: integrate the mover's observed motion (start->stop) to recover its heading, then attribute its goal as the one in the heading direction. The 3 goals are EQUIDISTANT from the mover's frozen stop, so the single frame is provably SYMMETRIC and ONLY the motion identifies g*.
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: MEMORYLESS baseline PROVABLY at chance (0.32 -- symmetric single frame is an airtight control by construction) vs recurrent 0.86 => needs-memory +0.54. mover-FROZEN (sits at the stop, no motion) -> 0.32 chance => needs-mover +0.54.
failed_by: memoryless (symmetric single frame -> chance BY CONSTRUCTION)
competencies.lit_name: intention attribution / inverse planning / machine theory-of-mind (Baker 2009; Rabinowitz et al. 2018)
competencies.note: FIRST SCALE-TIER competency. The audit flagged ToM as SCALE-GATED (not demandable at toy scale); this validates the instrument at the scale tier and shows the richer mechanism DOES emerge once forced. DIRECT RICHER SUCCESSOR to #19 on a social-cognition DEPTH LADDER: #19 solved a hidden-goal task by EMULATION (the cheap shortcut); this probe is literally 'close that shortcut' and one rung up is INTENTION-READING => emulation -> intention-attribution, and closing the shortcut at one rung forces the next. Required closing SIX successive single-frame shortcuts (fixed centre; perpendicular decoy offset; too-short trajectory; middle-distance ordering; ...; finally provable symmetry) before velocity-integration emerged -- the STRONGEST demonstration of the minimal-mechanism law: the agent grabbed every cheaper mechanism until a provably-symmetric frame left motion-integration as the ONLY sufficient one. METHODOLOGICAL FINDING: forcing a richer competency requires adversarially removing EVERY cheaper mechanism; the count of shortcuts that must be closed is a candidate MEASURE of how far up the mechanism ladder a competency sits. KNOWN to science => still 0 new-to-science.

competencies.name: cumulative-culture ratchet (cross-generational)
competencies.state_required: n/a -- the state is EXTERNALIZED in a persistent culture buffer that outlives any individual
competencies.state_content: an accumulated cultural ARTIFACT (the known-correct recipe prefix) persisting across agent lifetimes
competencies.mechanism: each generation inherits the culture prefix, COPIES it (imitation) and explores the FRONTIER symbol (innovation); discoveries accumulate into the buffer, so the recipe is solved ACROSS generations, never within one
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: REMOVE the inherited culture buffer (no-inheritance) -> collapses 11.69/12 (97%) -> 0.38/12 (3%); needs-inheritance +11.31. A single generation cannot discover a random length-12 recipe (exponential); cross-generational accumulation can.
competencies.metric: cumulative 11.69/12 (97%) vs single-generation 0.38/12 (3%); ratchet gap +11.31 (confirmed @120 generations)
reached_by: cross-generational accumulation (persistent cultural strategy + persistent culture buffer)
failed_by: no-inheritance (single generation; buffer disabled -> plateaus at chance)
competencies.lit_name: cumulative cultural evolution / the ratchet effect (Tomasello; Boyd & Richerson; Henrich; Kirby iterated learning)
competencies.note: FIRST CROSS-GENERATIONAL competency in the catalog -- all prior 20 + the entire coordination cascade are WITHIN-lifetime. Adds a NEW AXIS: the TEMPORAL SCALE of competency (within-lifetime vs across-lifetime). Mechanistically composes imitation (#19) + frontier innovation + a persistent artifact (#15 externalized state) ACROSS generations -> all closed-set primitives, so NO new primitive medium (consistent with completeness). BUT it is a genuine new KIND -- a system reaching solutions NO individual could -- and the ONLY probe in the whole hunt that did NOT reduce to a within-lifetime mechanism (no-inheritance plateaus at 3%). Known (cumulative cultural evolution) => still 0 new-to-science; the strongest new-FEELING result of the scale tier.
